productionDelay.description: Supplier misses production deadline — goods arrive late
mitigation: Confirm production slot in writing when deposit is paid
Follow up at weeks 2, 4, and 1 week before ship date
Build 1-week production buffer into all quoted lead times
For custom or complex orders: negotiate penalty clause for late production

qualityFailure.description: Goods arrive in Australia not conforming to specification or damaged during manufacture
mitigation: Conduct or commission pre-shipment quality inspection for orders above $30,000 COGS
Require supplier quality photos before goods are sealed in cartons
Maintain clear specification document signed by supplier with each order
Warranty clause: supplier replaces or refunds within 60 days of defect notification

priceChangeRisk.description: Supplier increases prices between quote and order placement
priceChangeRisk.probability: Medium — AUD/CNY fluctuation is the primary driver
mitigation: Request supplier price lock for 30 days when issuing quotes to clients
Quote validity stated as 30 days — beyond this, re-confirm supplier pricing
Build 5% buffer into all landed cost estimates to absorb minor currency moves

supplierInsolvency.description: A primary supplier ceases trading — product range no longer available
mitigation: Maintain approved backup suppliers for all major product categories
Never advance-pay more than 30% before production commencement
Reduce exposure by spreading orders across multiple suppliers where possible

IPAndBrandingRisk.description: Supplier uses TCD's branding or collection names for other markets, or TCD designs are copied
mitigation: Include brand exclusivity clause in supplier agreements for Australian market
Do not provide custom branding or collection naming to suppliers without IP protection

newSupplier: Factory audit (virtual or in-person) before first large order
Sample order minimum 1–3 units before committing to volume
Confirm certifications (ISO, BIFMA, SGS, CE) match product claims
ongoingMonitoring: Review supplier performance quarterly: on-time delivery rate, quality defect rate, responsiveness
Benchmark pricing annually against alternative suppliers
Visit key suppliers annually if volume justifies (>$200k/year COGS)
